index.description: The selected index in the original collection.

dragging.description: Whether the wheel is being dragged.

scrolling.description: Whether the wheel is settling to an item.

items.description: The visual items to render on the 3D wheel.

highlightItems.description: The items to render in the clipped highlight layer.

scrollToIndex.description: Smoothly scroll to a collection index.

getItemState.description: Get the derived state for a visual item.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the wheel picker. Useful for composition.

value.description: The controlled value of the wheel picker.

defaultValue.description: The initial value of the wheel picker when rendered.

onValueChange.description: Function called when the selected value changes.

onValueChangeEnd.description: Function called when scrolling to a value finishes.

onScrollChange.description: Function called when the centered item changes while scrolling.

infinite.description: Whether the wheel should loop infinitely.

visibleCount.description: The number of items on the circular ring. Values are rounded down to a multiple of 4.

dragSensitivity.description: The distance the wheel coasts after a drag. Higher values increase the coast distance; lower positive values reduce it.

scrollSensitivity.description: The speed of step-based scrolling. Higher values make scrolling settle faster; lower positive values make it settle more slowly.

optionItemHeight.description: The height of each item in pixels.

disabled.description: Whether the wheel picker is disabled.

readOnly.description: Whether the wheel picker is read-only.

invalid.description: Whether the wheel picker is invalid.

required.description: Whether a value is required for form submission.

name.description: The name of the form field.

form.description: The id of the form that owns the hidden select.

aria-label.description: The accessible label for the wheel picker.

aria-labelledby.description: The id of the element that labels the wheel picker.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

enabled.description: Whether sourcery runs. The Next.js adapter turns it on for `next dev`, the others when `NODE_ENV` is `development`.

injectTo.description: Absolute path of the module the browser client is injected into, usually a root client component.

exclude.description: Path fragments to skip. `node_modules` is always skipped.

hotKeys.description: Keys held together to start inspecting.

editor.description: Editor to open: a known id (`code`, `cursor`, `zed`, `webstorm`, …), a command or a path. Detected when unset.

port.description: First port tried for the local open-in-editor server.

root.description: Directory source paths are recorded relative to.

ignoreTags.description: Extra element or component names to leave untagged, on top of `Fragment`, `Suspense`, `script`, `style`, `template` and `slot`.

panda.description:
Also record where Panda CSS `styled()`, `withProvider()`, `withContext()` and `withRootProvider()` components are
defined. Hold ⌥ with the hotkeys to open that definition. `modules` lists the import paths treated as Panda's `jsx`
entry, matched as suffixes.
